s.note: Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sage and mustard pork sausage, crumbed and fried golden
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 7 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Mix 400g pork sausage mince with 1 tbsp chopped sage, 2 tsp hot English mustard and pepper, divide into 4 and wrap around each egg. Roll in 50g flour, 1 beaten egg and 80g panko. Deep fry in oil at 170C for 6 to 7 minutes until deep golden and cooked through, drain, salt and halve.

s.note: Crisp potato and cabbage cakes fried in butter, with brown sauce
s.how: Boil 700g peeled floury potatoes until tender, drain and mash roughly. Fry 1 sliced onion and 250g shredded savoy cabbage in 20g butter until soft and catching. Mix into the potato, season and shape into 8 flat cakes, dust with 2 tbsp flour and chill for 20 minutes. Fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 4 minutes a side until crusted. Serve with 4 tbsp brown sauce.

m.note: Beef mince, carrot and peas in rich gravy under cheddar-topped mash
m.how: Brown 700g beef mince in 1 tbsp oil, add a diced onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 2 garlic cloves and soften. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp flour, add 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp dried thyme and simmer for 30 minutes. Mash 1.2kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Stir 150g peas into the mince, top with the mash and 80g grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Buttered bread and sultanas baked in vanilla custard with nutmeg and a crunchy sugar top
w.how: Butter 8 slices of day-old white bread with 50g butter, cut into triangles and layer in a buttered dish with 60g sultanas. Whisk 3 eggs, 300ml milk, 200ml cream, 70g caster sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, pour over and soak for 20 minutes. Grate over nutmeg, sprinkle with 1 tbsp demerara sugar and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set. Rest 10 minutes.

d.note: Dark chocolate and cocoa whisked into hot milk with cinnamon and a pinch of chilli
d.how: Whisk 1 litre full cream milk with 2 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar, half a tsp cinnamon and a pinch of chilli until steaming. Off the heat, whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of salt until smooth, then whisk hard over low heat until frothy. Pour into 4 heavy mugs.
